_comment: Rust classic naming rules. Checked top to bottom; the first rule that matches gives the library id. No match = unknown_ai. Units: MHz, us. Override the file with CLASSIC_LIBRARY=/path/to/file.json. Keys: f = [min, max] carrier (mode, 0.1 MHz bins); pw_max_ge = 99th-percentile pulse width >= value; lfm_ge = share of lfm_up pulses >= value; pri_lt = PRI (mode of gaps) < value; pri = PRI fundamental (us) measured on this radar: v3 names a group only when its PRI fundamental is within CLASSIC_NAME_PRI_TOL (3 %) of it, so a look-alike on the same carrier with another pulse train stays unknown.
